verses: الٓر تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ
إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ
قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/04-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: The people mock God's messengers, despise his words and scoff at his prophets (weight 5.4). Pair score 5.4.

Only in Last kings of Judah, burning of the temple, exile and seventy years: God's wrath rises until there is no remedy; The enemy kills the young men by the sword in the sanctuary; Overlord imposes a fine of 100 talents of silver and a talent of gold; While the people are in exile, the desolate land makes up its missed sabbath years; The temple of Jerusalem is burned and the city walls broken down; The enemy enters the sanctuary (masjid) a second time as the first and destroys all; Vassal king rebels against the overlord who made him swear by God; Foreign overlord deposes a king and renames his replacement; The 'people of the land' kill the conspirators or choose and enthrone a king; God sends his messengers 'rising early and sending' out of compassion; The temple treasures and gold vessels of Solomon are carried off to Babylon; A child of eight to twelve years becomes king; and 1 more.

Only in The guarded reminder, the guarded heaven and the fertilizing winds (Surah 15:1-25): Opponents demand that the prophet bring the angels if he is truthful; Even if a door of heaven were opened and they ascended, they would say their eyes were bewitched; No town is destroyed without a known written decree; no nation outstrips its term; God sends the winds as fertilizers (lawaqih), then rain to drink; God declares that he sent down the Reminder and will himself guard it; God made everything grow in due weight and sends it down only in known measure; Jinn or devils who used to sit listening at heaven's gates now find it full of stern guards and shooting stars (shuhub) lying in wait; There is nothing whose storehouses are not with God; God gives life and death and is the inheritor of the earth and all on it; God set constellations (buruj) in the sky and adorned it for beholders; Defense of the prophet: there is no madness (jinna) in your companion; he is only a warner; God set the mountains as pegs or firm anchors (awtad, rawasi) for the earth; and 1 more.

leads.summary: 7 correspondences read side by side: 6 deliberately changed, 1 same element.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/04-hb-quran.yaml).

Shared motifs, rarest first: The townsmen remind Lot they had forbidden him to receive outsiders (weight 6.7); Host offers his virgin daughters to the mob to protect his guests [divergence between the texts] (weight 6.7); Lot's wife is among those who stay behind and perish [divergence between the texts] (weight 6.7); The angelic guests reveal they are sent against a criminal people [divergence between the texts] (weight 6.7); Two angels are received as guests by Lot in Sodom [divergence between the texts] (weight 6.7); Cities overturned (hafakh) and the plain destroyed [divergence between the texts] (weight 6.7); Command not to look back while fleeing a doomed place [divergence between the texts] (weight 6.7); Command not to look back while fleeing a doomed place (weight 6.3); Two angels are received as guests by Lot in Sodom (weight 6.0); Townsmen surround the house and demand the male guest for sexual abuse (weight 6.0); Host offers his virgin daughters to the mob to protect his guests (weight 6.0); Cities overturned (hafakh) and the plain destroyed (weight 5.6); Hero's family saved with him (weight 4.5). Pair score 81.2.

Only in Lot's guests and the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah: A small town is spared at the refugee's request (Zoar, 'small'); Angels seize the hesitating family by the hand and lead them out; The angels tell Lot who sent them and what they will do [divergence between the texts]; Deniers pray: 'If this is the truth from you, rain stones on us from the sky'; God rains destruction on Lot's town [divergence between the texts]; The fate of Lot's wife [divergence between the texts]; God rains sulfur and fire from heaven on cities [divergence between the texts]; Lot's family is saved at the time before dawn (bi-sahar) while a storm of stones (hasib) destroys the rest; Only Lot's household is brought out of the doomed city; Only Lot's household is brought out of the doomed city [divergence between the texts]; What Lot says to the townsmen; What Lot says to the townsmen [divergence between the texts]; and 29 more.

Only in Abraham's guests and the destruction of Lot's people (Surah 15:51-77): The angelic guests reveal they are sent against a criminal people; The rescued family leaves by night, the leader following behind them; God swears by the prophet's life (la-'amruka); The patriarch tells his unknown guests 'we are afraid of you'; The ruins of the destroyed towns lie on a road still traveled; The doomed people are seized by the Shout (al-sayha) at dawn or sunrise; Do not despair of God's mercy (rawh / rahma); only unbelievers or the astray despair; The patriarch tells his unknown guests 'we are afraid of you' [divergence between the texts]; Patriarch or matriarch laughs at the promise of a child in old age [divergence between the texts]; Lot's wife is among those who stay behind and perish; Stones of baked clay (sijjil), in layers, each marked by the Lord, rain on the town; God appears as three men who visit the patriarch; and 2 more.

matches.label: Two angels are received as guests by Lot in Sodom
matches.note: Gen: Lot rises to meet them at the gate, bows, presses them to stay and bakes maṣṣôt. Q: Lot greets them coldly, innakum qawmun munkarūn ('you are strangers'). Hospitality is replaced by unease, as with Abraham.

passages.text: וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵ֨י הַמַּלְאָכִ֤ים סְדֹ֨מָה֙ בָּעֶ֔רֶב וְל֖וֹט יֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּשַֽׁעַר סְדֹ֑ם וַיַּרְא לוֹט֙ וַיָּ֣קָם לִקְרָאתָ֔ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ אַפַּ֖יִם אָֽרְצָה
וַיֹּ֜אמֶר הִנֶּ֣ה נָּא אֲדֹנַ֗י ס֣וּרוּ נָ֠א אֶל בֵּ֨ית עַבְדְּכֶ֤ם וְלִ֨ינוּ֙ וְרַחֲצ֣וּ רַגְלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּ֖ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֣ם לְדַרְכְּכֶ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לֹּ֔א כִּ֥י בָרְח֖וֹב נָלִֽין
וַיִּפְצַר בָּ֣ם מְאֹ֔ד וַיָּסֻ֣רוּ אֵלָ֔יו וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל בֵּית֑וֹ וַיַּ֤עַשׂ לָהֶם֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וּמַצּ֥וֹת אָפָ֖ה וַיֹּאכֵֽלוּ
فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

matches.label: The angelic guests reveal they are sent against a criminal people
matches.note: Order reversed. Gen: first the mob (19:4-11), then the angels reveal kî-mašḥitîm ʾănaḥnû ʾet-hammāqôm hazzeh (19:13). Q: the messengers state their mission and order the flight (15:63-66, dābira hāʾulāʾi maqṭūʿun muṣbiḥīn), and only then do the townsmen come (wa-jāʾa ahlu l-madīnati yastabshirūn).

matches.note: Gen: at dawn (kəmô haššaḥar ʿālâ) the angels drag the lingering Lot out by the hand; ʾal-tabbîṭ ʾaḥărêkā. Q: by night, fa-asri bi-ahlika bi-qiṭʿin mina l-layl wa-ttabiʿ adbārahum wa-lā yaltafit minkum aḥad: no hesitation, and Lot walks behind his family.

leads.summary: 5 shared motifs, found by the separate reads; not yet compared side by side.

evidence.text: Shared motifs, rarest first: The expelled devil vows to lie in wait on the straight path and mislead humanity (weight 6.3); The devil (Iblis) alone refuses to bow to the first man (weight 5.8); The devil asks for and is granted respite until the day the dead are raised (weight 5.8); God commands the angels to prostrate before the first man, and they do (weight 5.8); First human shaped from dust, clay or soil (weight 4.6). Pair score 28.2.

Only in The prostration to Adam, Iblis' refusal and the fall: Man and wife are addressed, tempted and eat together; the woman is not singled out; The first humans are sent down to earth to live and enjoy provision for a time; The devil will come at humans from before, behind, right and left; The first couple confess 'we have wronged ourselves' and ask God's forgiveness; On the earth humans live, in it they die, and from it they will be brought out; The tempter claims the tree is forbidden only lest the couple become angels or immortals; The tempter swears an oath to the first couple that he is their sincere adviser; God vows to fill hell with the devil and all who follow him; Satan whispers (waswasa) to tempt humans; God casts the proud being out from the mountain of God and destroys him from among the stones of fire, hurling him to earth before kings; How the first couple answer God after eating: shifting the blame or confessing [divergence between the texts]; God gives the adversary (Satan) leave to act against humans; and 17 more.

Only in Man from black mud, jinn from scorching fire, and Iblis's refusal (Surah 15:26-50): The pious are in gardens and springs, entering in peace and security; Hell has seven gates, each with an assigned portion of the damned; The jinn were created before humans from smokeless or scorching fire; In paradise no fatigue touches them and they are never expelled from it; God removes all rancor from the hearts of those in paradise; Deity breathes the breath of life into the first human's nostrils [divergence between the texts]; Satan has no authority over God's sincere servants, only over those who follow him; God expels Iblis as accursed (rajim) with a curse until the Day of Judgment; Deity breathes the breath of life into the first human's nostrils.
